title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Psalms 2: the raging nations, the King set on Zion, and the call to the kings of the earth to be wise.

questions.text: What do the peoples plot, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: The psalm asks why the nations rage and the peoples plot a vain thing.

questions.text: Against whom do the kings of the earth take a stand?
questions.explanation: The kings and rulers take counsel together against Yahweh and against his Anointed.

answers.text: The sea and the dry land

questions.text: What do the kings and rulers want to break apart?
questions.explanation: They say, "Let's break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us."

questions.text: What will he who sits in the heavens do?
questions.explanation: He who sits in the heavens will laugh; the Lord will have them in derision.

questions.text: Where has the Lord set his King?
questions.explanation: He says, "Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion."

answers.text: On his holy hill of Zion
On the banks of the river

questions.text: What did Yahweh say to the speaker in the decree?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You are my son. Today I have become your father."

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise to give as an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance."

questions.text: With what will the nations be broken?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, "You shall break them with a rod of iron."

questions.text: How are the kings and judges told to serve Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They are told to serve Yahweh with fear and rejoice with trembling.

questions.text: Who are called blessed at the end of the psalm?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "Blessed are all those who take refuge in him."

answers.text: All those who take refuge in him
